metadata.title: Team Terra Architecture Atlas — ten-practice research pilot
metadata.coverage: Editorial pilot: two practices each in Europe, the Americas, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. Not a worldwide directory, census, ranking, or comprehensive office inventory.
metadata.location_policy: Professional public locations only, summarized at city or district level. No street numbers, home addresses, personal contact details, or private contacts are stored.
metadata.coordinate_policy: Markers are approximate GeoNames city reference points. They do not locate offices and are not surveyed city centroids.
metadata.coordinate_source_type: GeoNames geographic gazetteer; geographic reference only, not an architect registry.
metadata.status_policy: Official-page leadership or team statements are recorded as source assertions. Current operating and professional registration status are not inferred from a website.
metadata.attribution: Practice facts: the linked official practice/contact pages. City reference points: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/, licensed CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

practices.name: Assemble
practices.professional_public_location: Professional office in Bromley-by-Bow, London, listed on the practice's official Contact page.
practices.discipline_summary: Design and making of buildings, artworks, gardens, playgrounds, furniture, exhibitions, events, and workspaces.
practices.current_roster_note: The About page describes a cooperative partnership; no named current roster was verified.

coordinates.note: Approximate London city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: White Arkitekter
practices.professional_public_location: Professional head office in Gothenburg, explicitly identified as the head office on the official office page.
practices.discipline_summary: Architecture, landscape architecture, sustainability, urban design, and interior architecture and design.
practices.current_roster_note: The official office page names Jacob Sahlqvist as Office Director and identifies him as an architect and interior architect. A complete current roster was not verified.

coordinates.note: Approximate Gothenburg city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: Tatiana Bilbao Estudio
practices.professional_public_location: Professional studio in Colonia Juarez, Cuauhtemoc, Mexico City, listed on the official Contact page.
practices.discipline_summary: Architecture spanning masterplans, affordable housing strategies, city planning, and furniture design.
practices.current_roster_note: The official Contact page lists six partners. This is a published partner list, not independent confirmation of a complete current staff roster.

coordinates.note: Approximate Mexico City city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: Al Borde
practices.professional_public_location: Professional studio named El Zoologico in Quito, explicitly listed under Studio Address on the official Contact page; the separate postal address is not used.
practices.discipline_summary: Architecture using local resources and techniques, with user participation in design and construction and an emphasis on sustainability.
practices.current_roster_note: The official short biography identifies four practice leaders. A complete current staff roster was not verified.

coordinates.note: Approximate Quito city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: Counterspace
practices.professional_public_location: Professional practice contact in Parkwood, Johannesburg, listed on the official Practice page.
practices.discipline_summary: Architectural design, research, publishing, pedagogy, and built work, examining African and Islamic identities.
practices.current_roster_note: The official page identifies Sumayya Vally as founder and Principal and says she leads the practice. A complete current staff roster was not verified.

coordinates.note: Approximate Johannesburg city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: Cave_bureau
practices.professional_public_location: Nairobi-based architectural working group. Its official contact page lists a public mailing contact in Kilimani, Nairobi; a physical street-level office location was not established.
practices.discipline_summary: Architecture and spatial research concerning African settlements, social and ecological repair, geology, and anthropology.
practices.current_roster_note: The official About page identifies Kabage Karanja and Stella Mutegi as architects and co-founding directors and lists consulting team roles. Roster completeness and independent currentness were not verified.

coordinates.note: Approximate Nairobi city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: Studio Lotus
practices.professional_public_location: Professional office in Lado Sarai, New Delhi, listed on the official Contact Us page.
practices.discipline_summary: Architecture and spatial design, including masterplans, buildings, and interiors, with attention to local context, skills, and resources.
practices.current_roster_note: The About page names the practice's founders; a current staff roster was not verified for this record.

coordinates.note: Approximate New Delhi city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: WOHA
practices.professional_public_location: Professional office on HongKong Street, Singapore, listed on the official Contact page.
practices.discipline_summary: Integrated design across masterplanning, architecture, landscape, interiors, lighting, and furniture.
practices.current_roster_note: The About page names the founders; a current staff roster was not verified for this record.

coordinates.note: Approximate Singapore city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: Andrew Burges Architects
practices.professional_public_location: Professional studio in Surry Hills, New South Wales, listed on the official Practice page and normalized to Sydney for this city-level pilot.
practices.discipline_summary: Civic and public buildings, single residential dwellings, multi-residential housing, and masterplanning.
practices.current_roster_note: The official People section lists Andrew Burges as Principal and names other studio members. The page also contains an undated staff-count statement; that count is not treated as a verified current total.

coordinates.note: Approximate Sydney city-level marker from a GeoNames populated-place record; not a surveyed centroid or the practice's office coordinates.

practices.name: Patchwork Architecture
practices.professional_public_location: Professional studio contact in Island Bay, Wellington, listed on the official About page.
practices.discipline_summary: Residential, multi-residential, commercial, and civic architecture, drawing on practical building experience.
practices.current_roster_note: The official About page lists seven studio team members. The listing is undated and is not independent confirmation of current employment.
